message.reasoning_content:
The kernel computes rstd = 1/(sqrt(mean_square)+eps) instead of 1/sqrt(mean_square+eps). This is the standard Liger kernel formula actually (Liger uses 1/(sqrt(mean_square+eps))). The contract explicitly requires rstd = 1/sqrt(mean_square + eps). The kernel adds eps after sqrt — a contract violation. Also the stated stabilizer behavior: as row norm → 0, kernel gives 1/(0+eps)=1/eps vs contract 1/sqrt(eps). Contract says "must keep the normalizer finite" — both are finite, but the formula is explicitly required. So this is in_scope violation.

Record claim, run probe comparing, confirm.
